notCovered: use of any G004 raw image (G004_LABELING_AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIED)
use of any production candidate image (not authorized for labeling)

renameNote: Renamed on 2026-09-11 while zero human labels existed. The class means no lettering, logo, brand mark or watermark at all; the old name implied text only, although GRAPHICAL_LOGO and BRAND_TEXT_OR_MARK are part of the same taxonomy.
supersedes: avatar_watermark_label_schema_v1, never merged. It asked humans to label OCR_HALLUCINATION, which is a model error: a human looking at an image can only see that no text is there. v2 keeps what a person observes separate from what is derived by comparing that observation with model output.
labelUnit: One generated candidate image is one unit with one primary image-level label. Region annotations are optional and added only when an evaluation needs localisation. Ground truth is image-first so it cannot inherit the OCR model's region errors.

NO_VISIBLE_RELEVANT_TEXT_OR_MARK.definition: No visible lettering, logo, brand mark or watermark anywhere in the image.

GARMENT_TEXT.definition: Lettering printed on clothing or accessories the subject wears, following fabric folds and lighting.

BACKGROUND_SIGNAGE.definition: A sign, poster or screen that belongs to the photographed scene.

BRAND_TEXT_OR_MARK.definition: A brand name or mark rendered on a real object in the scene, not composited over the image.

OVERLAY_TEXT.definition: Text composited over the image, independent of scene geometry and lighting, that is not a creator or provider mark.

OVERLAY_WATERMARK.definition: A creator, tool, platform or stock-provider mark composited over the image: often semi-transparent, repeated, or at an edge or corner.

GRAPHICAL_LOGO.definition: A logo composited over the image, with or without text.

GENERATIVE_TEXT_ARTIFACT.definition: Letter-like shapes the generator invented that do not read as a real word.

UNCERTAIN.definition: The rater cannot decide. Excluded from primary metrics and reported separately.

multiLabelRule: When several classes are visible, the primary label is the first in primaryLabelPrecedence; every visible class is also recorded in allVisibleClasses.

OCR_HALLUCINATION.derivation: Primary human label NO_VISIBLE_RELEVANT_TEXT_OR_MARK, and OCR reported at least one text region.

OCR_MISS.derivation: Primary human label in visibleTextClasses, and OCR reported no text region.

REGION_MISS.derivation: A human region annotation with no overlapping OCR region, using a cut pre-registered before the evaluation runs.

OCR_TRANSCRIPTION_MISMATCH.derivation: A human transcription that differs from the normalised OCR text for the same region.
OCR_TRANSCRIPTION_MISMATCH.requires: region annotations and an ephemeral human transcription; see transcriptionHandling

transcriptionHandling.allowedUse: ephemeral, inside an authorized evaluation process only, to derive OCR_TRANSCRIPTION_MISMATCH
transcriptionHandling.storedResult: typed mismatch outcome only (match | mismatch | not_evaluated); never the text itself

raterMustNotSee: the other rater's label during the first pass
raterSees: optionally the source image, only to judge whether a visible mark was already present in it
blinding.rationale: A label derived from the policy's own output measures agreement with the policy, not correctness.

storage.mappingRule: Any evaluationId-to-image mapping lives in a separate restricted local authority and is never committed or exported.

forbidden: production user images repurposed without consent covering this purpose
copying production images to a new store
extending retention of any media for labeling

metrics.acceptance: No policy change is accepted on candidate metrics alone. Lower scene-native flag rate with higher risk-positive miss rate is not accepted automatically; higher recall that worsens zero-preview jobs is not accepted automatically. B1 (2026-08) looked better per candidate and moved zero-preview jobs from 1/5 to 4/5.
